
'''Tsubaki Shrine''' (椿神社) refers to various [[Shinto shrine]]s across Japan.

* [[Tsubaki Shrine (Ōta)]] - A shrine located in [[:en:Ōta|Ōta]], [[Tokyo]].
* Tsubaki Shrine - A common name for [[Tsubaki Grand Shrine]] in [[Suzuka]], [[Mie Prefecture]].
** Tsubaki Shrine - Shrines dedicated to [[Sarutahiko Ōkami|Sarutahiko]] across Japan, though few are directly related to the Tsubaki Ōkami Yashiro.
* Tsubaki Shrine - An alternate name for [[Iyozuhiko-no-Mikoto Shrine]] in [[Matsuyama]], [[Ehime Prefecture]].
